name: Sentimental Gensoukyou
source: One day, Morichika Rinnosuke receives a mysterious letter. It contains only one word: "Boredom". He then sets out to find out who is behind this.
translation: One day, Morichika Rinnosuke receives a mysterious letter. It contains only one word: "Boredom". He then sets out to find out who is behind this.
